knownIssues.title: VPN client returns 'Authentication failed' error
knownIssues.content: Usually caused by a Keycloak SSO session timeout or an incorrect certificate. Solution: 1) Delete the VPN profile from the client and re-download it. 2) Manually copy the certificate under 'C:\Program Files\VPN Client\certs'. 3) Enter the server name as 'vpn.corp.local'.

knownIssues.title: Internet drops after connecting to VPN
knownIssues.content: When split tunneling is disabled, DNS routing may be set up incorrectly. Solution: In the VPN profile, disable the 'Use default gateway on remote network' option and clear the route table (route /f).

knownIssues.title: Cisco AnyConnect 'Login denied, unauthorized connection mechanism' error
knownIssues.content: The user is connecting to the wrong tunnel group; the group-policy does not match on the ASA side. Solution: In the AnyConnect profile, select 'CORP-SSL' in the 'Group' field, and the client version must be compatible with the minimum defined on the ASA (4.10+).

knownIssues.title: FortiClient throws 'SSL_connect error' and fails with code 14
knownIssues.content: The TLS 1.2 negotiation is being intercepted by the proxy. Solution: Add 'use_legacy_ssl_adapter=1' under 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Fortinet\FortiClient\Sslvpn' and set ssl-cipher to 'high'; add 'vpn.corp.local' to the corporate proxy bypass list.

knownIssues.title: GlobalProtect 'Could not connect to gateway' error
knownIssues.content: The portal certificate has expired or the CRL check failed. Solution: Review 'C:\Program Files\Palo Alto Networks\GlobalProtect\PanGPS.log', and re-add the Palo Alto root CA certificate to Trusted Root on the machine via 'certlm.msc'.

knownIssues.title: VPN tunnel establishes but intranet pages won't load
knownIssues.content: Routes are pushed but the DNS suffix 'corp.local' has not been assigned. Solution: Check ConnectionSpecificSuffix for the VPN adapter in the 'Get-DnsClient' output, and if missing run the command 'Set-DnsClient -InterfaceAlias "PPP-VPN" -ConnectionSpecificSuffix corp.local'.

knownIssues.title: MFA push notification doesn't arrive at VPN login
knownIssues.content: In the Keycloak integration with Duo/Authy, the RADIUS challenge timeout has dropped to 12 seconds. Solution: On the ASA, set 'aaa-server CORP-RADIUS timeout 30'; on the user side, verify that the device clock is synced with NTP (w32tm /resync).

knownIssues.title: VPN client stays stuck in 'reconnecting' state on Mac
knownIssues.content: On macOS 14 Sonoma the network extension permission is denied, so DPD packets are dropped. Solution: Grant permission to the Cisco/Forti agent under System Settings > Privacy & Security > Network Extensions, then restart the network stack with 'sudo killall -HUP configd'.

knownIssues.title: VoIP/Teams audio is choppy while VPN is connected
knownIssues.content: The connection has fallen back to a TCP tunnel instead of UDP; jitter is increasing. Solution: Enable 'DTLS' or 'UDP tunnel mode' in the AnyConnect/FortiClient profile, and open UDP/443 in the firewall on the gateway side.

knownIssues.title: 'The VPN client driver encountered an error' (anyconnect.sys) causes a BSOD
knownIssues.content: The vpnva-6 driver is incompatible with Windows 11 23H2. Solution: Stop the driver with 'sc query vpnva' and install AnyConnect 4.10.08025+; disable the vEthernet adapters owned by the Hyper-V Virtual Switch via 'Get-NetAdapterBinding'.

knownIssues.title: Always-On VPN device tunnel won't come up, only the user tunnel establishes
knownIssues.content: The machine certificate is missing from the 'Local Computer\Personal' store or its EKU is wrong. Solution: Re-push the SCEP profile from Intune, verify the certificate with the Client Authentication EKU in 'certlm.msc', then check the status with 'Get-VpnConnection -AllUserConnection'.

knownIssues.title: Very slow copying when accessing an SMB share over VPN
knownIssues.content: The MTU value (1500) is fragmenting because of the PPP headers. Solution: Apply 'netsh interface ipv4 set subinterface "PPP-VPN" mtu=1400 store=persistent'; also try 'Set-SmbClientConfiguration -EnableBandwidthThrottling $false' for SMB.

knownIssues.title: Cannot connect to the corporate Wi-Fi (CORP-SECURE)
knownIssues.content: PEAP-TLS is required instead of MSCHAPv2 over WPA2-Enterprise. Solution: In the network settings, select 'Authentication: PEAP', 'Inner authentication: EAP-MSCHAPv2', 'Validate server certificate: On', and enter the domain account.

knownIssues.title: Guest Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting
knownIssues.content: The DHCP pool is exhausted, so no IP can be obtained after the lease expires. Temporary solution: Assign a static IP (range 10.10.20.50-100). Permanent solution: The network team expands the pool to /23.

knownIssues.title: Laptop won't connect to CORP-SECURE due to a certificate error
knownIssues.content: The Aruba ClearPass RADIUS server certificate has been renewed from the internal CA, but the machine still has the old root CA. Solution: Distribute the new 'CorpRootCA-2026' via GPO under 'Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings > Public Key Policies', then run 'gpupdate /force'.

knownIssues.title: The 5GHz SSID is visible but the laptop falls back to 2.4GHz
knownIssues.content: 'Preferred Band' is unset and roaming aggressiveness is low in the Intel AX201 driver. Solution: In Device Manager > Wi-Fi adapter > Advanced, set 'Preferred Band: 5GHz' and 'Roaming Aggressiveness: Highest'; update the driver to Intel's 22.250+ version.

knownIssues.title: There is a Wi-Fi signal in meeting rooms but packet loss is high
knownIssues.content: The Meraki MR access points are colliding on a shared channel (channel 6). Solution: Enable Auto-RF under Meraki Dashboard > Radio Settings, lower the 'Min bitrate' to 12 Mbps; identify microwave/Bluetooth sources with a spectrum analyzer.

knownIssues.title: Wi-Fi adapter shows a 'No internet, secured' warning
knownIssues.content: Because the NCSI probe cannot reach 'www.msftncsi.com', Windows considers the network to be without internet; the connection actually works. Solution: Add a proxy exception, or apply 'EnableActiveProbing=0' under 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\NetworkConnectivityStatusIndicator'.

knownIssues.title: New iPhones say 'Unable to join' for CORP-SECURE
knownIssues.content: Because the private MAC address (Private Wi-Fi Address) is enabled on iOS 17, Aruba ClearPass does not recognize the device. Solution: Disable 'Private Wi-Fi Address' under Settings > Wi-Fi > SSID, or create a policy in the ClearPass profile that tolerates MAC randomization.

knownIssues.title: Session drops during roaming in the elevator/stairwell area
knownIssues.content: 802.11r (Fast Transition) is disabled on the controller, so a full EAP is renewed on every transition. Solution: Enable 'FT over-the-DS' for the SSID on the Aruba/Cisco WLC, and '802.11r' support must be enabled in the client's driver settings.

knownIssues.title: Printer connects to Wi-Fi but drops off after 30 seconds
knownIssues.content: PMF (Protected Management Frames) is mandatory, and the old printer firmware does not support it. Solution: Set PMF to 'Optional' for the relevant SSID on the WLC, or create a separate 'IOT' SSID (WPA2-PSK) for the printer with a MAC filter added.

knownIssues.title: DNS resolves slowly on the office Wi-Fi without VPN
knownIssues.content: DHCP option 6 is sending the wrong DNS (8.8.8.8), so internal zone resolution is delayed. Solution: Set 10.0.0.10 / 10.0.0.11 as the primary and secondary DNS on the DHCP scope; on the client side apply 'ipconfig /release' + 'ipconfig /renew'.

knownIssues.title: Wi-Fi adapter shows 'Code 10' in Device Manager
knownIssues.content: The driver throws an error after waking from Modern Standby. Solution: Reset the adapter with 'pnputil /restart-device'; for a permanent fix, update the OEM (Lenovo/Dell) Wi-Fi driver and disable 'Allow this device to wake the computer'.

knownIssues.title: Mobile data is used on BYOD phones even when Wi-Fi is on
knownIssues.content: When the captive portal (Aruba ClearPass Guest) HTTPS redirect fails, the device says 'no internet' and falls back to LTE. Solution: Sign the portal certificate with the corporate CA instead of Let's Encrypt, and add 'captive.apple.com' / 'connectivitycheck.gstatic.com' to the walled garden list.

knownIssues.title: Certain ports (445, 3389) are blocked on the office network
knownIssues.content: Per the security policy, SMB and RDP are kept closed to the office from the outside for internal file/remote-desktop traffic. You must connect over VPN.

knownIssues.title: Ping to the network printer doesn't go through
knownIssues.content: The printer is on VLAN 30 and the user computers are on VLAN 10. Check the ACL; if missing, the network team adds a rule for the 10→30 printer ports.

knownIssues.title: User port doesn't get a link, the switch LED is off
knownIssues.content: The Cisco Catalyst 9300 port is in an err-disable state (BPDU guard triggered). Solution: Verify with 'show interface Gi1/0/24 status', then apply 'shutdown' followed by 'no shutdown'; if it recurs, the user's switch is removed.

knownIssues.title: Can't get an IP from DHCP on the new floor (169.254.x.x)
knownIssues.content: The DHCP relay (ip helper-address) is undefined on the new VLAN 40 SVI. Solution: On the core switch, add 'ip helper-address 10.0.0.20' under 'interface Vlan40'; obtain an IP on the client with 'ipconfig /renew'.

knownIssues.title: Wired network speed drops to 100Mbit instead of 1Gbit
knownIssues.content: The Cat5e cable is damaged or the patch panel pinout has T568A/T568B mixed up. Solution: Test the cable with a Fluke tester, re-crimp the RJ45 if necessary; leave 'speed auto / duplex auto' on the switch port.

knownIssues.title: VoIP phone won't power on with POE
knownIssues.content: The switch port POE budget has been exceeded or 'power inline never' is configured. Solution: Check the budget with 'show power inline', set 'power inline auto' in the port config; class 3 phones require a minimum of 15.4W.

knownIssues.title: No link from the Cat6 outlet in the conference room
knownIssues.content: The patch panel label is wrong; the port is actually passive. Solution: List the active ports with 'show mac address-table interface', and if there is no match, trace the cable; leave unused ports as 'shutdown' to ensure security.

knownIssues.title: Two users on the same VLAN can't ping each other
knownIssues.content: A private VLAN or port isolation is active. Solution: Check with 'show vlan private-vlan'; if isolation is not wanted on meeting/guest VLANs, change to the standard 'switchport mode access'.

knownIssues.title: All connections slowed down after a network scan (nmap)
knownIssues.content: Traffic is being throttled because the Storm Control or IPS (Palo Alto) threshold was exceeded. Solution: Check with 'show storm-control'; review the zone-protection drops in the Threat logs for the relevant user, and add an exception if it's a false positive.

knownIssues.title: MAC address flapping warning constantly appears in the logs
knownIssues.content: The same MAC is bouncing between two ports; likely a loop or an incorrectly set up second uplink. Solution: Find the ports with 'show mac address-table address xxxx.xxxx.xxxx', and if there is a loopback, enable Spanning-Tree (RPVST+) loop guard.

knownIssues.title: User isn't admitted to the network via 802.1X dot1x
knownIssues.content: In the Cisco ISE policy, the Active Directory group membership doesn't match or the certificate is expired. Solution: Review the 'Authentication failed' detail in ISE Live Logs; if necessary re-push the 'wired_dot1x' profile and start the 'wired AutoConfig' service on the machine.

knownIssues.title: Broadcast storm between devices plugged into the same switch
knownIssues.content: A user plugged in their own mini switch and created a loop with a double cable. Solution: Enable 'errdisable recovery cause bpduguard', make 'spanning-tree bpduguard enable' mandatory on all access ports; warn the user.

knownIssues.title: A new SaaS application is blocked by the firewall
knownIssues.content: The relevant SaaS provider's IP list must be added to the 'allowed-destinations' rule. It is usually listed under the 'IP ranges' heading in the vendor documentation.

knownIssues.title: FTP transfers time out
knownIssues.content: For passive FTP, the 49152-65535 port range must be allowed outbound. Active mode is no longer supported; enable passive mode on the client side.

knownIssues.title: Microsoft Teams drops due to Palo Alto NGFW SSL decrypt
knownIssues.content: Because Teams uses a pinned certificate, MITM decryption fails. Solution: Define a 'no-decrypt' rule in the decryption policy for 'application teams-base, teams-audio, teams-video'; add 'business-and-economy/teams.microsoft.com' as an exception in the URL category.

knownIssues.title: 'policy lookup failed' log messages on the Fortigate
knownIssues.content: Traffic is hitting the default deny rule; likely the new subnet (10.0.50.0/24) is not defined as an address object. Solution: Create a new object under 'config firewall address' and add it as the source to the relevant policy, then verify with 'diagnose debug flow'.

knownIssues.title: Outbound DNS (UDP/53) was closed on the firewall, resolution is broken
knownIssues.content: After DoH/DoT was made mandatory, the old 53/udp rule was removed. Solution: Open TCP/853 (DoT) for the internal resolver (10.0.0.10), or with an exception rule allow 53/udp outbound only from the resolver IP.

knownIssues.title: Site-to-site IPsec tunnel drops in phase 2
knownIssues.content: The PFS group is mismatched (DH14 vs DH19) or the lifetime is mismatched. Solution: Verify the parameters with 'diagnose vpn ike gateway list' / 'show crypto ipsec sa'; apply the IKEv2 + AES256-SHA256 + DH19 + 3600 sec lifetime standard on both ends.

knownIssues.title: European partner traffic is intermittent due to the GeoIP filter
knownIssues.content: The GeoIP database is out of date; the partner IP is a new allocation. Solution: Refresh the feed with 'request system external-list refresh' on Palo Alto, or 'execute update-now' on Fortigate; temporarily add the relevant /24 to the explicit allow list.

knownIssues.title: User is blocked because the application is 'identified as unknown-tcp'
knownIssues.content: App-ID does not recognize the custom application. Solution: Write an 'Application Override' policy or define a 'Custom Application' (signature: dst port 8443, payload pattern 'CORP-APP'); then allow this application in the security policy.

knownIssues.title: Threat Prevention gives a 'brute-force-login' false positive
knownIssues.content: Because the load balancer health check sends TCP SYNs at short intervals, the IPS is triggered. Solution: Add a threat exception to exempt threat ID '40031' for the LB IP (10.0.5.5), and temporarily set the action to 'alert'.

knownIssues.title: External service sees the wrong source IP after NAT
knownIssues.content: A static one-to-one NAT is required instead of Hide NAT (PAT). Solution: Map the public IP with 'config firewall vip' on Fortigate, and with a route-map add a source NAT exception only for the relevant host; verify the IP in the partner whitelist.

knownIssues.title: DPI (Deep Packet Inspection) corrupts PDF downloads
knownIssues.content: The AV scan works in stream-based mode and overflows the buffer on large files. Solution: Raise the antivirus profile 'oversize-limit' to 50MB, or disable 'stream mode' and set the inspection to 'proxy-based' instead of 'flow-based'.

knownIssues.title: Firewall logs aren't reaching the SIEM (Splunk)
knownIssues.content: The syslog target IP has changed, or TCP/6514 is expected instead of UDP/514. Solution: Define the new HEC collector (10.0.6.50:6514) under 'config log syslogd setting', enable certificate validation; verify the end-to-end flow with 'diagnose log test'.

knownIssues.title: Cannot reach internal services (corp.local)
knownIssues.content: The DNS server is 10.0.0.10/11 at the office. The DNS may be misconfigured on the client. Run ipconfig /flushdns followed by nslookup corp.local.

knownIssues.title: Some external sites return 'DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN'
knownIssues.content: The caching DNS cache may be corrupted. Solution: 'ipconfig /flushdns' + clear the browser cache. If it persists, restart the internal resolver.

knownIssues.title: Active Directory replication gives a DNS error
knownIssues.content: The _msdcs.corp.local zone delegation is missing or the SRV records have been deleted. Solution: Run 'dcdiag /test:dns' and 'repadmin /replsummary'; if missing, restart the 'netlogon' service to re-register the SRV records.

knownIssues.title: Conditional forwarder (azure.corp) queries are dropping
knownIssues.content: The forwarder target (168.63.129.16) is blocked on the firewall or the forwarder cache lifetime has been set to 0. Solution: Open UDP/53 outbound to the Azure DNS IP on the firewall, and update MasterServers with 'Set-DnsServerConditionalForwarderZone'.

knownIssues.title: DNSSEC validation error (SERVFAIL) on certain domains
knownIssues.content: The internal resolver requires DNSSEC but the upstream chain is broken. Solution: Verify with 'Resolve-DnsName -DnssecOk', temporarily disable validation for the relevant zone; for a permanent fix, ask the domain owner to fix the DS records.

knownIssues.title: Users are getting the wrong proxy via WPAD
knownIssues.content: Because a domain other than 'corp.local' is first in the DNS suffix search list, wpad.attacker.tld is being resolved. Solution: Fix the order with GPO 'Append these DNS suffixes'; define a wpad A record on the internal DNS and remove 'wpad' from the global query block list.

knownIssues.title: An internal site doing round-robin load distribution falls back to a single node
knownIssues.content: Because the TTL is 3600 sec, the client cache is not refreshed. Solution: Lower the TTL of the A records on the zone to 60 sec; if a real LB is needed, F5/HAProxy is recommended instead of DNS.

knownIssues.title: Public DNS (1.1.1.1) is still used while VPN is connected
knownIssues.content: Because of Windows 'smart multi-homed name resolution', queries are sent in parallel to all adapters. Solution: Apply GPO 'Turn off smart multi-homed name resolution: Enabled'; set a lower metric (1) on the VPN adapter.

knownIssues.title: Office 365 services can't find 'autodiscover'
knownIssues.content: On the internal DNS, the old 'autodiscover.corp.com' CNAME still points to Exchange 2016. Solution: Update the record to the 'autodiscover.outlook.com' target, verify with 'Test-OutlookWebServices' / Microsoft Remote Connectivity Analyzer.

knownIssues.title: Reverse DNS (PTR) is missing, the mail server is rejected
knownIssues.content: The spam filter (Proofpoint) rejects mail if there is no PTR. Solution: Request a PTR record for the /29 block from the ISP, define the PTR as 'mail.corp.com' in the in-addr.arpa zone; verify with 'dig -x 1.2.3.4'.

knownIssues.title: DNS server uses high memory in cache and slows down
knownIssues.content: Due to cache poisoning or a very large zone transfer, the Windows DNS process consumes 4GB+. Solution: Apply 'dnscmd /clearcache', and limit the 'MaxCacheSize' registry value to 524288000 (500MB) under 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\DNS\Parameters'.

knownIssues.title: On Linux clients, systemd-resolved doesn't resolve the internal zone
knownIssues.content: The 127.0.0.53 stub resolver is used by default, and /etc/resolv.conf has been edited by hand. Solution: Define 'DNS=10.0.0.10 10.0.0.11' and 'Domains=corp.local' under '/etc/systemd/resolved.conf', then 'systemctl restart systemd-resolved' followed by verifying with 'resolvectl status'.

knownIssues.title: Outlook hangs with 'Trying to connect' warning
knownIssues.content: The OST file in Cached Exchange Mode may be corrupted. Fix: with Outlook closed, rename the .ost under %localappdata%\Microsoft\Outlook, then reopen it.

knownIssues.title: Emails disappeared after the profile was deleted
knownIssues.content: Data is not lost on the server side; once the profile is re-added, Cached Mode resynchronizes all the data. Depending on mailbox size, this takes between 15 minutes and 2 hours.

knownIssues.title: Outlook search returns no results 'We couldn't complete your search'
knownIssues.content: The Windows Search index is corrupted. Go to Control Panel > Indexing Options > Advanced > click 'Rebuild'. Keep Outlook closed; on large mailboxes, indexing can take 1-3 hours.

knownIssues.title: Outlook reports 'The profile could not be loaded' at startup
knownIssues.content: The profile's registry entry is corrupted. Delete the relevant profile under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Outlook\Profiles, then create a new profile via Control Panel > Mail (Microsoft Outlook) and set it as the default.

knownIssues.title: Shared mailbox is not added automatically
knownIssues.content: The AutoMapping flag may be disabled. In Exchange Online, run 'Remove-MailboxPermission' followed by 'Add-MailboxPermission -AutoMapping $true -AccessRights FullAccess' to re-grant access. The client side updates within 60 minutes at the latest.

knownIssues.title: Cannot see the email in the Sent Items folder
knownIssues.content: A POP3 account may be saving locally, or the 'Delegate Sends' setting is broken. Go to File > Options > Mail > check 'Save copies of messages in the Sent Items folder'; in the delegate scenario, apply 'Set-MailboxSentItemsConfiguration -SendAsItemsCopiedTo SenderAndFrom'.

knownIssues.title: Outlook signature disappears when sending
knownIssues.content: In new Outlook (Monarch), cloud signature sync is disabled or 'roamingsignatures' is corrupted. Back up the files under %appdata%\Microsoft\Signatures, then add the DWORD 'DisableRoamingSignaturesTemporaryToggle=1' under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Outlook\Setup.

knownIssues.title: Outlook prompts for a password every time it opens
knownIssues.content: Modern Authentication is disabled or an old account entry in Credential Manager is corrupted. Go to Control Panel > Credential Manager > delete the 'MicrosoftOffice16_Data:*' entries; when Outlook reopens, the MFA flow is triggered.

knownIssues.title: Autocomplete (NK2) suggestions do not appear
knownIssues.content: The RoamCache folder is corrupted. With Outlook closed, delete the Stream_Autocomplete*.dat files under %localappdata%\Microsoft\Outlook\RoamCache; the list is rebuilt, but old entries are not recovered from the OST.

knownIssues.title: Outlook OST file exceeded the 50GB limit
knownIssues.content: The default size limit for Cached Mode has been reached. As a temporary fix, set the 'Sync slider' to 12 months; for a permanent fix, set 'MaxLargeFileSize=102400' (KB) under HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Office\16.0\Outlook\PST.

knownIssues.title: Outlook add-ins (COM Add-ins) keep getting disabled
knownIssues.content: Slow-loading add-ins are automatically disabled by Outlook. Go to File > Slow and Disabled COM Add-ins and select 'Always enable'; via GPO, define the 'DoNotDisableAddinList' policy for the add-in's ProgID.

knownIssues.title: Outlook 365 version reports a 'License error'
knownIssues.content: The Office Activation token has expired or an M365 E3/E5 license has not been assigned to the user. Read the status at the command line with 'cscript ospp.vbs /dstatus'; if needed, trigger a refresh with 'OfficeC2RClient.exe /update user', and check the license in the M365 admin center.

knownIssues.title: Sending a large attachment (>25MB) is rejected
knownIssues.content: Exchange policy enforces a 25MB upper limit. Fix: send it as a sharing link via SharePoint/OneDrive.

knownIssues.title: Emails land in spam due to DMARC
knownIssues.content: Check the sender domain's SPF/DKIM/DMARC records. If any are missing, open a request to the DNS team to add the records.

knownIssues.title: External recipient gets an 'NDR 550 5.7.1 Relay denied' error
knownIssues.content: On the Exchange Online connector, the recipient domain is blocked by a transport rule or is incorrectly defined as internal/relay in 'Accepted Domains'. In EAC > Mail Flow > Accepted Domains, set the domain type to 'Authoritative', then re-test with a message trace.

knownIssues.title: Mail appears sent but does not reach the recipient
knownIssues.content: In Exchange Online, trace it with 'Get-MessageTrace -SenderAddress kullanici@corp.local -StartDate (Get-Date).AddHours(-2)'. It is usually stuck in the Mimecast hold queue; release it under 'Held Messages' in the admin console.

knownIssues.title: Sending to a Distribution List returns 'group does not accept messages from outside'
knownIssues.content: 'RequireSenderAuthenticationEnabled=$true' is active on the DL. In Exchange Online PowerShell, allow external sending with 'Set-DistributionGroup -Identity grup@corp.local -RequireSenderAuthenticationEnabled $false'.

knownIssues.title: Sending is greyed out despite having 'Send As' permission
knownIssues.content: Permission propagation can take 1 hour; also, the 'From' field is hidden in the Outlook profile. Go to View > turn on the 'From' field; if needed, re-apply 'Add-RecipientPermission -Identity kutu -Trustee kullanici -AccessRights SendAs' and test immediately via OWA.

knownIssues.title: 'Throttling 432 4.7.0' error during bulk mail sending
knownIssues.content: EXO's limit of 10,000 recipients per hour / 30 messages per minute has been exceeded. A 'High Volume Email' license is recommended for the service account, or send via Azure Communication Services Email; for newsletter traffic, prefer a tool such as Mailchimp.

knownIssues.title: Mail gets stuck in the Outlook Outbox
knownIssues.content: Usually a corrupted attachment or offline mode. On the Send/Receive tab, turn off 'Work Offline', double-click the item in the Outbox, remove the attachment, and resend. If that doesn't resolve it, repair the PST with 'scanpst.exe'.

knownIssues.title: Turkish characters in the mail body are sent garbled
knownIssues.content: The character encoding is set to Western European (ISO-8859-1). Go to Outlook > Options > Advanced > International options > select 'Preferred encoding for outgoing messages: Unicode (UTF-8)'.

knownIssues.title: Sending an encrypted (S/MIME) mail returns 'certificate not found'
knownIssues.content: The recipient's public key is not in the GAL or the certificate has expired. In EAC > Recipients > Mailboxes > user > 'Email encryption', publish the certificate; obtain a signed mail from the recipient and save their public key to Contacts.

knownIssues.title: Read receipt is not received
knownIssues.content: An organization transport rule or the user's 'Never send a read receipt' setting in OWA is blocking it. Reset the behavior with Set-MailboxMessageConfiguration -Identity kullanici -ReadReceiptResponse 'PromptUser'; some mobile clients do not support MDN at all, so manage expectations accordingly.

knownIssues.title: 'This item could not be sent 0x80040115' error while sending
knownIssues.content: OST corruption or a Cached Mode sync conflict. First stop the 'All Accounts' sync in the Send/Receive settings, reset the profile with /resetnavpane; if the problem persists, create a new Outlook profile.

knownIssues.title: Emails mistakenly sent to quarantine
knownIssues.content: Release the messages from the Mimecast quarantine interface and add the sender to the 'permitted senders' list, so it does not recur.

knownIssues.title: What to do if a phishing email is clicked
knownIssues.content: 1) Close the browser. 2) Change the password immediately. 3) Report the incident to IT Security (security@corp.local). 4) Start an endpoint EDR scan.

knownIssues.title: Defender for Office 365 Safe Links breaks URLs
knownIssues.content: Some CRM/ERP links return 404 after rewrite. In Defender portal > Policies > Safe Links, add the relevant domain (e.g. crm.partner.com) to the 'Do not rewrite' list; it takes 30 minutes to become active.

knownIssues.title: Spoofing: mail arrives to us from our own address
knownIssues.content: An external sender is impersonating an internal address. In EAC > Mail flow > Rules, add the rule 'If sender is outside the organization AND From address matches *@corp.local then prepend [EXTERNAL] and set SCL 9'; harden SPF to '-all'.

knownIssues.title: User account triggers a foreign-country login alert
knownIssues.content: Review the event in the Entra ID 'Risky sign-ins' report. Apply 'Revoke sessions' and 'Require password change' for the user; verify the Conditional Access 'Block legacy authentication' policy.

knownIssues.title: Macros in mail attachments were automatically blocked
knownIssues.content: Microsoft's default VBA macro block policy is in effect. Right-click the file > Properties > 'Unblock' is sufficient; for trusted corporate sources, add the UNC path under the GPO 'Trusted Locations', and do not grant manual exceptions to users.

knownIssues.title: How to perform a header analysis of a suspicious mail
knownIssues.content: In OWA, open the mail > '...' > View > View Message Details and copy the header, then paste it into the Microsoft Message Header Analyzer (mha.azurewebsites.net). If you see SPF/DKIM/DMARC=fail in the 'Authentication-Results' line, report it to DLP as phishing.

knownIssues.title: Mimecast 'attachment management' converts the attachment to PDF
knownIssues.content: Per policy, XLS/DOC attachments are converted to PDF as a 'safe file'. In Mimecast admin > Gateway > Policies > Attachment Management, share the user self-service portal link to request the original file.

knownIssues.title: Unwanted mail may have been sent from my account
knownIssues.content: The account may be compromised. In Exchange Online, run 'Search-MailboxAuditLog -Identity kullanici -Operations SendAs,Send -StartDate ...'; check the Inbox rules and delete suspicious rules with 'Get-InboxRule | Remove-InboxRule', then enforce MFA.

knownIssues.title: Defender ATP Safe Attachments delays the attachment by 10 minutes
knownIssues.content: The detonation chamber scan time is normally 30 seconds to 5 minutes, but lengthens under load. Enable 'Dynamic Delivery' mode so the body is delivered to the user immediately and the attachment once scanning completes; the policy is configured under Defender portal > Safe Attachments.

knownIssues.title: Phishing emails containing QR codes (quishing) bypass the filter
knownIssues.content: Traditional URL scanners do not decode the QR. In Defender for Office 365 Plan 2, enable the 'QR code threats' feature; with a transport rule, quarantine mails that 'has attachment of type image/png AND subject contains MFA/login'.

knownIssues.title: Mails from external senders do not carry the 'External' banner
knownIssues.content: The external sender tag is disabled. In EXO PowerShell, apply 'Set-ExternalInOutlook -Enabled $true'; OWA and new Outlook show it instantly, while classic Outlook shows it in version 16.0.14931+. Partner domains can be added to the allowlist with 'Set-ExternalInOutlook -AllowList @{Add="partner.com"}'.

knownIssues.title: Meeting room reservation does not appear
knownIssues.content: The room is defined as a resource mailbox; calendar sharing must be opened to the user. IT adds 'Reviewer' permission to the room resource.

knownIssues.title: A single day in a recurring meeting series does not change
knownIssues.content: In the Outlook web version, the 'This event' option sometimes fails to save because it inherits from the old series. Fix: open and save that single meeting from desktop Outlook.

knownIssues.title: As a delegate, cannot add a new meeting to the manager's calendar
knownIssues.content: The delegate permission is assigned as 'Reviewer' instead of 'Editor'. In EXO PowerShell, run 'Add-MailboxFolderPermission -Identity yonetici:\Calendar -User asistan -AccessRights Editor -SharingPermissionFlags Delegate'.

knownIssues.title: Meeting time appears different to the recipient
knownIssues.content: Time zone mismatch; the sender is on UTC+3, the recipient is still on UTC+1 in OWA. In OWA > Settings > General > Region and time zone, set it to 'Istanbul'; for the client side, run 'tzutil /s Turkey Standard Time'.

knownIssues.title: Room resource auto-accepts conflicting meetings
knownIssues.content: AutomateProcessing is in 'AutoAccept' mode and AllowConflicts is $true. Harden the policy with 'Set-CalendarProcessing -Identity oda@corp.local -AutomateProcessing AutoAccept -AllowConflicts $false -MaximumDurationInMinutes 480'.

knownIssues.title: Meeting invite responses do not reach the organizer
knownIssues.content: An inbox rule moves the responses to another folder, or 'Tracking' is disabled. Go to Outlook > File > Options > Mail > Tracking > check 'Automatically update meeting requests with responses'; additionally, review the organizer's rules with 'Get-InboxRule'.

knownIssues.title: Shared calendar does not update in Outlook
knownIssues.content: In REST-based sharing, the 'Shared Calendar Improvements' flag is missing. It comes automatically in Outlook 16.0.13127+; in older versions, remove and re-add the user from sharing, and delete the calendar cache under '%localappdata%\Microsoft\Outlook'.

knownIssues.title: Teams meeting link is not added to the invite
knownIssues.content: The Teams Meeting add-in is disabled or the 'Online Meeting' policy is off. Go to Outlook > Manage Add-ins > enable 'Microsoft Teams Meeting Add-in for Office'; in Teams admin > Meeting policies > 'Allow Outlook add-in' must be On.

knownIssues.title: Past meetings disappeared from the calendar
knownIssues.content: A retention policy applied 365 days to the 'Calendar' folder. Recover them from Recoverable Items with 'Search-Mailbox -Identity kullanici -SearchQuery kind:meetings -TargetMailbox ... -TargetFolder Recovered'; going forward, extend the duration with 'Set-RetentionPolicyTag'.

knownIssues.title: Meeting attendee list returns a 'Could not be updated' error
knownIssues.content: The mailbox audit log and the 'Calendar Repair Assistant' may not have been triggered. Run 'New-MailboxRepairRequest -Mailbox kullanici -CorruptionType ProvisionedFolder,SearchFolder,AggregateCounts,FolderView'; monitor completion with 'Get-MailboxRepairRequest'.

knownIssues.title: iPhone calendar does not sync with Exchange
knownIssues.content: The iOS native client sometimes drops the modern auth token. Go to Settings > Mail > Accounts > Exchange > remove the account and re-add it as 'Microsoft Exchange'; if there is a Conditional Access 'Approved client apps' policy, Outlook for iOS is recommended.

knownIssues.title: Meeting room list (Room Finder) comes up empty
knownIssues.content: No RoomList is defined. Create one with 'New-DistributionGroup -Name "Kat3-Odalar" -RoomList', add the rooms with 'Add-DistributionGroupMember'; the client side sees the list within 24 hours after the GAL OAB update.

knownIssues.title: No audio during a Teams call
knownIssues.content: Usually Teams' microphone is disabled in the Windows Sound mixer. Go to Settings > Privacy > Microphone > turn on Teams. If it continues, clear the 'Teams Modern Auth' cache.

knownIssues.title: Teams screen sharing shows a black screen
knownIssues.content: GPU acceleration may be conflicting with Citrix VDI. Fix: go to Settings > General > enable 'Disable GPU hardware acceleration', and restart the application.

knownIssues.title: Teams constantly shows 'Reconnecting'
knownIssues.content: Proxy/SSL inspection is breaking Teams traffic. Add *.teams.microsoft.com, *.skype.com, *.lync.com to the SSL bypass list; clear the client cache under '%appdata%\Microsoft\Teams' (classic) or '%localappdata%\Packages\MSTeams_*' (new).

knownIssues.title: New Teams (v2) does not open and reverts to classic Teams
knownIssues.content: WebView2 Runtime is missing or the corporate policy is 'UseNewTeamsClient=Disabled'. Install WebView2 Evergreen; in Teams admin > Teams update policies > set 'Use new Teams client' to Enabled.

knownIssues.title: In a Teams meeting others can hear me but I cannot hear them
knownIssues.content: The wrong output device is selected, or the Windows 'Communications' feature is reducing other sounds by 100%. From Audio > During the meeting > Device settings, select the correct speaker; go to Control Panel > Sound > Communications tab > check 'Do nothing'.

knownIssues.title: Teams chat history does not appear before a certain date
knownIssues.content: A retention policy of 90 days may have been applied. Review the policy in Compliance portal > Data lifecycle management > 'Teams chats'; for a user that requires an exception, apply a new retention policy with a separate adaptive scope.

knownIssues.title: Teams file upload returns error '0xCAA20003'
knownIssues.content: The Modern Auth token is corrupted. For classic Teams, delete %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams\Cookies and Local Storage; for new Teams, run 'wsreset.exe' followed by 'Get-AppxPackage MSTeams | Reset-AppxPackage'.

knownIssues.title: Camera in a Teams meeting returns a 'Can't start video' error
knownIssues.content: Another application (Snipping Tool, OBS) may be holding the camera. Go to Settings > Privacy > Camera > turn on 'Allow apps to access your camera'; update the camera driver from Device Manager, and if it continues, switch the USB hub using 'usbview'.

knownIssues.title: External user cannot wait in the 'Lobby' for a Teams meeting
knownIssues.content: The meeting policy 'Anonymous users can join' is Disabled. In Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > Global, set 'Anonymous users and dial-in callers can start a meeting' to On; also check 'Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -DisableAnonymousJoin $false' at the tenant level.

knownIssues.title: Teams notification sound plays but there is no visual alert
knownIssues.content: Windows Focus Assist is in 'Priority only' mode. Go to Settings > System > Notifications > turn off Focus; in Teams Settings > Notifications > 'Show notification banners' must be On, and the banner style should be 'Banner and action center', not 'Only show in action center'.

knownIssues.title: Teams channel access to SharePoint files returns 'Sorry, you don't have access'
knownIssues.content: The channel's SharePoint site permissions are out of sync. The channel owner checks 'Manage team > Members'; in SharePoint admin, go to site > Permissions > trigger 'Run sync', and if needed apply 'Sync-UnifiedGroup'.

knownIssues.title: 'Couldn't schedule the meeting' error when scheduling a Teams meeting from Outlook
knownIssues.content: No Teams license is assigned to the user, or 'MeetingPolicy' AllowPrivateMeetingScheduling is $false. Check the license in M365 admin > user; assign the default policy with 'Grant-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity kullanici -PolicyName Global'.

knownIssues.title: Device is plugged in to charge but does not charge
knownIssues.content: 1) Make sure the charging adapter is 65W+. 2) Reinstall the battery driver from Device Manager. 3) If it persists, run 'powercfg /batteryreport' for a battery health report.

knownIssues.title: Device overheats and slows down
knownIssues.content: Dried-out thermal paste or a clogged fan is the likely cause. Temporary: select the 'Cool' profile in Dell PowerManager. Permanent: send the hardware in for service.

knownIssues.title: Asks for the BitLocker recovery key at startup
knownIssues.content: Triggered after a TPM or BIOS update. The key is obtained from Azure AD > Devices > BitLocker Keys. For a permanent fix, suspend it once with 'manage-bde -protectors -disable C:' and then re-enable it.

knownIssues.title: Device connects to Wi-Fi but there is no internet
knownIssues.content: First check DHCP/DNS with 'ipconfig /all'. Apply 'ipconfig /flushdns' and 'netsh winsock reset'. Update the Intel AX201 driver via Lenovo Vantage / Dell Command Update.

knownIssues.title: Fingerprint reader does not work in Windows Hello
knownIssues.content: Under Device Manager > Biometric devices, uninstall and reinstall the Goodix/Synaptics driver. Reset the fingerprint via Settings > Sign-in options; if a TPM clear is needed, do it with 'tpm.msc'.

knownIssues.title: Built-in webcam does not appear in Teams
knownIssues.content: The camera shutter may be closed via the F4/Fn key. Settings > Privacy > Camera must be enabled. If it persists, uninstall the driver under Device Manager > Imaging devices with 'Uninstall device' and rescan.

knownIssues.title: Screens randomly turn off when a USB-C dock is plugged in
knownIssues.content: Update the Dell WD19 / HP G5 dock firmware with Dell Command Update or HP Firmware Installer. The USB-C cable must support at least 100W PD; otherwise the dock cannot draw power.

knownIssues.title: Blue screen on resume from sleep mode (DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION)
knownIssues.content: Usually caused by the NVMe or graphics driver. Run 'sfc /scannow' and 'DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth'. Update the Intel RST and graphics drivers from the OEM portal.

knownIssues.title: Keyboard backlight does not work
knownIssues.content: Try the backlight level with Fn+F5 / Fn+Space. On Dell/Lenovo, check 'Keyboard backlight timeout' via the OEM application (Dell Power Manager / Lenovo Vantage). Reset the setting under BIOS Setup > System Configuration.

knownIssues.title: Device does not turn on, power LED is off
knownIssues.content: Unplug the adapter and hold the power button for 30 seconds to drain residual power. On devices with removable batteries, remove the battery. If that does not help, test the adapter on another device; if it persists, refer it to service as a motherboard fault.

knownIssues.title: No sound from the internal speakers, but there is sound in headphones
knownIssues.content: Select 'Speakers (Realtek/Conexant)' as the device under Settings > Sound > Output. Reinstall the Realtek HD Audio driver from the OEM site. Under 'services.msc', the Windows Audio service must be Automatic + Started.

knownIssues.title: SD card reader does not detect the card
knownIssues.content: Update the Realtek/Genesys card reader driver under Device Manager > Memory technology devices. Test the card in another reader; if it is corrupted, repair the file system with 'chkdsk X: /f'.

knownIssues.title: External monitor connects but there is no picture
knownIssues.content: Check whether the DisplayPort cable is plugged in correctly. Select 'Extend' with Win+P. If it persists, update the driver (Intel/NVIDIA) and check the docking station firmware.

knownIssues.title: A single dot flickers on the second monitor (dead pixel)
knownIssues.content: 1 pixel is within acceptable tolerance. With 3+ pixels, a warranty replacement is performed.

knownIssues.title: Colors on the monitor look washed out or yellowish
knownIssues.content: First set the 'Color Preset' to Standard/sRGB from the OSD menu. Reset the Windows > Settings > Display > Color profile. For calibration, run 'dccw.exe' (Display Color Calibration).

knownIssues.title: Text is blurry and small on a 4K monitor
knownIssues.content: Set Settings > Display > Scale to 150% or 175%. For per-application DPI override, select exe > Properties > Compatibility > 'Override high DPI scaling' = Application.

knownIssues.title: Monitor is stuck at 60 Hz, 144 Hz cannot be selected
knownIssues.content: A DisplayPort 1.2+ or HDMI 2.0+ cable must be used. Select the refresh rate under NVIDIA Control Panel > Change resolution. If the driver is out of date, install the Studio/Game Ready driver via GeForce Experience.

knownIssues.title: Monitor does not wake from sleep mode
knownIssues.content: Try the 'DisplayPort 1.1 / 1.2' compatibility mode from the OSD menu. On the Dell U2722 series, set 'Deep Sleep' to Off. Try a cable swap and a different port (HDMI instead of DP).

knownIssues.title: Horizontal/vertical lines on the screen image
knownIssues.content: First try the cable on another port. Connect the same monitor to a different computer; if the problem goes away it is the GPU or the cable, if it persists the panel is faulty and a warranty process is started.

knownIssues.title: A monitor connected with a single USB-C cable does not charge the device
knownIssues.content: Set the monitor's OSD > USB-C Charging setting to 'On in Power Off'. Verify that the cable supports at least 65W/90W PD. On Dell P/U series monitors, update the firmware via Dell Display Manager.

knownIssues.title: Lag when moving a window between two monitors
knownIssues.content: Match the refresh rate of the two monitors in the Display settings. Keep G-Sync off under NVIDIA Control Panel > Configure Surround. Prefer the same cable standard (both DP).

knownIssues.title: Image dims when the monitor is switched to HDR mode
knownIssues.content: When Windows > Display > HDR > 'Use HDR' is on, SDR content may look washed out. Balance it with the 'SDR content brightness' slider. HDR400 panels do not deliver full HDR; turn HDR off if needed.

knownIssues.title: Meeting room projector does not detect the laptop
knownIssues.content: Unplug and replug the HDMI cable, select Win+P > Duplicate. Fix the projector to the HDMI 1/2 input instead of 'Auto Source'. If a dongle is used, verify that it supports USB-C alt-mode (DP Alt).

knownIssues.title: 'No Signal' message keeps cycling on the monitor
knownIssues.content: Unplug and replug the cable at both ends. Manually set OSD > Input Source to the correct port. If there is integrated graphics on the motherboard plus a discrete GPU, the cable must be plugged into the correct output (the GPU).

knownIssues.title: Network printer queues the job but does not print
knownIssues.content: Restart the Print Spooler service (Services.msc → Print Spooler → Restart). If it persists, reinstall the driver.

knownIssues.title: Printer does not perform double-sided (duplex) printing
knownIssues.content: 'Two-sided printing' may be off in the driver settings. Set printer properties > Device Settings > Duplex Unit = Installed.

knownIssues.title: Constant paper jams on the HP LaserJet
knownIssues.content: Adjust the Tray 2 guides to the paper size. Clean or replace the pickup roller (usually at 50,000 pages). Update the firmware via HP FutureSmart.

knownIssues.title: Toner warning does not clear on a Brother multifunction printer
knownIssues.content: Remove the toner cartridge and apply the drum reset procedure (Menu > General Setup > Replace Toner > Continue). If a third-party toner is used, a chip reset may be required.

knownIssues.title: Xerox WorkCentre scanner pulls two pages at once in the ADF
knownIssues.content: Clean/replace the ADF separator pad and feed roller. Enable 'Detect Multi-Feed' in the scan profile. Check for a firmware update via CWIS (CentreWare).

knownIssues.title: Color shift in color printing on a Konica Minolta bizhub
knownIssues.content: Run 'Color Registration Adjust' from the Service menu. Check the drum unit life (Utility > Counter > Supply Status). An IU replacement may be required.

knownIssues.title: Printer does not scan over SMB
knownIssues.content: SMBv1 is disabled on Windows 11; if the printer does not support SMBv2/v3, update the firmware. Define a separate AD user for the target folder and grant 'Modify' NTFS permissions. Use a domain user instead of 'Everyone'.

knownIssues.title: Print Spooler service keeps stopping
knownIssues.content: Clear the C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS folder (after stopping the service). Remove old/faulty drivers with 'printui /s /t2'. Prefer the Type 4 (v4) driver.

knownIssues.title: Vertical white stripe on printouts
knownIssues.content: On laser printers, the drum or the toner distribution surface is dirty. Shake the toner and wipe the drum surface with a lint-free cloth. If it persists, replace the drum unit.

knownIssues.title: Wireless printer becomes invisible on the network
knownIssues.content: Assign a static IP to the printer (via DHCP reservation). mDNS/Bonjour may be disabled on some VLANs; in that case use 'Add Printer' > 'TCP/IP Port' with the IP. A firmware update can also resolve the issue.

knownIssues.title: PDF files come out blank when sent to the printer
knownIssues.content: Check 'Print as Image' under Adobe Reader > Print > Advanced. Using a PostScript driver instead of PCL may be the solution. Check whether the printer's PS module is licensed.

knownIssues.title: Color printer prints only black instead of colors
knownIssues.content: Turn off the Driver > Color > 'Print in Grayscale' option. 'Print in draft quality' must be off in Word/Excel. If the color toner level is 0, the printer automatically falls back to grayscale.

knownIssues.title: Bluetooth mouse keeps disconnecting
knownIssues.content: The battery may be low or the 2.4 GHz band may be congested. Solution: replace the battery; if the problem persists, 'unpair' the mouse and re-pair it.

knownIssues.title: Some keyboard keys do not work
knownIssues.content: Foreign matter may have gotten under the keypad; clean it with compressed air. If that does not solve it, send the keyboard in for service.

knownIssues.title: Logitech MX Master 3 does not switch between devices
knownIssues.content: Reconfigure 'Flow' from the Logi Options+ application. Try a manual channel change with the Easy-Switch button. If it is a Bolt receiver instead of a Unifying receiver, do the pairing with the Logi Bolt software.

knownIssues.title: NumLock comes up off at startup on the keyboard
knownIssues.content: In the Registry, set HKEY_USERS\.DEFAULT\Control Panel\Keyboard > InitialKeyboardIndicators = 2147483650. Set BIOS Setup > POST Behavior > NumLock = On.

knownIssues.title: @ and ' characters are swapped on the Turkish Q keyboard
knownIssues.content: Make sure the keyboard layout is 'Turkish Q' under Windows > Time & Language > Language > Turkish > Options. The ALT+SHIFT shortcut may be switching to the wrong layout; change the shortcut from Advanced keyboard settings.

knownIssues.title: Wireless keyboard types with a delay
knownIssues.content: Move the USB receiver from a USB 3.0 port to USB 2.0 (USB 3.0 causes 2.4 GHz interference). Replace the battery. Re-pair using the Logitech Unifying software.

knownIssues.title: Mouse cursor jumps on its own
knownIssues.content: It may be an optical sensor or surface issue; use a mousepad. Turn off 'Enhance pointer precision'. If there is a touchpad, check 'Disable when external pointing device is plugged in' from Device Manager.

knownIssues.title: Touchpad scroll does not work
knownIssues.content: Reinstall the Synaptics/ELAN driver from the OEM portal. Enable 'Drag two fingers to scroll' under Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Touchpad > Scroll & zoom.

knownIssues.title: CapsLock or ScrollLock LED does not light on the keyboard, but the key works
knownIssues.content: It is mostly an LED fault; there is no functional impact. For visual feedback, the TrayStatus / Logitech Options application can be used. It can be replaced under warranty.

knownIssues.title: Mouse registers a single click as a double click
knownIssues.content: The left-click micro switch may be worn out. A temporary workaround is to slow down the 'Double-click speed' under Settings > Mouse. Adjust 'Click latency' with Logitech G-Hub / Options; the permanent fix is a switch replacement.

knownIssues.title: USB keyboard is not detected during Windows setup
knownIssues.content: Set BIOS Setup > Advanced > USB Configuration > 'Legacy USB Support' = Enabled. Try the 2.0 (black) ports instead of USB 3.0. Integrate the USB 3.0 driver into the installation media.

knownIssues.title: Dell/HP-branded wired keyboard keeps reconnecting (USB device descriptor failed)
knownIssues.content: Turn off USB selective suspend: Control Panel > Power Options > Change plan settings > Advanced > USB settings > Disabled. Uninstall and rescan the Generic USB Hub drivers from Device Manager.

knownIssues.title: C: drive full warning
knownIssues.content: 1) Clean up with Disk Cleanup. 2) Clear %temp% and %appdata%\Local\Temp. 3) Enable OneDrive 'Files On-Demand'. 4) If the problem still persists, an SSD upgrade is evaluated by service.

knownIssues.title: Windows does not recognize the external disk
knownIssues.content: Check whether the disk appears in Disk Management. If it is not mounted, assign a drive letter. If it is corrupted, run chkdsk /f.

knownIssues.title: NVMe SSD gives a SMART warning (Bad sectors)
knownIssues.content: Read the SMART values with CrystalDiskInfo or Dell SupportAssist (Reallocated Sectors, Media Wearout). If there is a Critical Warning, back up the data immediately; the disk is replaced under warranty.

knownIssues.title: BitLocker-encrypted disk does not open on another machine
knownIssues.content: Obtain the recovery key from Azure AD > Devices > BitLocker keys or from Active Directory. Unlock it manually with the 'manage-bde -unlock D: -RecoveryPassword <key>' command.

knownIssues.title: USB flash drive gives a 'write-protected' warning
knownIssues.content: Check the physical lock switch. Apply 'diskpart' > select disk > 'attributes disk clear readonly'. Set the Registry HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\StorageDevicePolicies > WriteProtect = 0.

knownIssues.title: Network drive (mapped) does not connect at startup
knownIssues.content: Run the GPO or 'net use' script with 'Persistent: Yes'. The correct record must exist under Credential Manager > Windows Credentials. If SMB1 is disabled, verify that the server supports SMB2/3.

knownIssues.title: OneDrive sync stopped, files do not appear in the cloud
knownIssues.content: Reconnect after OneDrive icon > Settings > Account > Unlink this PC. If the path length exceeds the 400-character limit, it errors out; shorten the file path. For Office files, clear the Office Upload Cache.

knownIssues.title: 'cyclic redundancy check' error while copying a file
knownIssues.content: There is a bad sector on the disk surface. Run 'chkdsk X: /r' (it can take hours). If the error persists, recover as much as possible with Robocopy /ZB; replace the disk.

knownIssues.title: SSD performance has degraded over time
knownIssues.content: Check whether TRIM is active: 'fsutil behavior query DisableDeleteNotify' should be 0. Update the firmware with Samsung Magician / Crucial Storage Executive. The disk should be kept below 75% full.

knownIssues.title: 'unallocated' space cannot be merged in Disk Management
knownIssues.content: Delete the recovery partition in between with Diskpart: 'diskpart' > select disk > select partition > delete partition override. Then use Disk Management > Extend Volume. A backup must be taken first.

knownIssues.title: 'access denied' error on the file server, permissions look correct
knownIssues.content: Calculate the permission for the user from the Effective Access tab. Take the intersection of NTFS and Share permissions (the most restrictive wins). If DFS is used, check the 'Access-Based Enumeration' behavior.

knownIssues.title: Computer gives a 'No bootable device' error at startup
knownIssues.content: BIOS > Boot > Boot Mode = UEFI, with Secure Boot at the appropriate setting. NVMe must be first in the boot order. For a corrupted bootloader, run Windows installation media > Repair > 'bootrec /fixmbr /fixboot /rebuildbcd'.

knownIssues.title: ERP report crashes with an 'Out of memory' error
knownIssues.content: The date range may be too wide (>1 year). Solution: pull the report in 3-month slices. If that doesn't resolve it, converting the report into a scheduled job is recommended.

knownIssues.title: Module cannot be assigned to a new user in ERP
knownIssues.content: First verify that the realm role is correct. Then add the user to the 'Authorized Modules' list via ERP-Admin; the cache refreshes after 5 minutes.

knownIssues.title: SAP GUI returns a 'Partner not reached' error
knownIssues.content: Verify the Application Server and System Number under SAP Logon > Connection > Properties > Network tab. Usually the saprouter string (/H/saprouter.firma.local/S/3299/H/) was entered incompletely; pasting the correct string fixes the connection.

knownIssues.title: 'Incompatible database version' when logging into Logo Tiger3
knownIssues.content: The client version differs from the server version. Run 'Version Update' via SYSCliMan, or download the patch with the Logo Update.exe on the user's machine. The session cannot be opened until the service is restarted.

knownIssues.title: When issuing an invoice in Netsis Wings, the e-Fatura is not sent to GİB
knownIssues.content: Usually the integrator (Logo Connect / Mali Mühür) certificate has expired. Check Mali Mühür Component > Certificate Status, install a new certificate from Kamu SM if necessary, and restart the 'LogoConnectService' service.

knownIssues.title: Oracle EBS crashes with an 'FRM-92101' error
knownIssues.content: A Forms Server crash is typical. Examine the frmweb log under $LOG_HOME/ora/10.1.2/forms; there is usually a JRE version mismatch. On the user side, install Java 8u202 32-bit and add the EBS URL to the Exception Site List.

knownIssues.title: Dynamics 365 F&O page says 'You are not authorized'
knownIssues.content: The newly added security role has not yet been reflected in the cache. Run System administration > Setup > Security > 'Refresh user authorization'. If that has no effect, verify the user's AAD group.

knownIssues.title: ERP batch job is stuck in 'Executing' status
knownIssues.content: The batch worker may be unable to send a heartbeat to the AOS. In SQL, find the relevant AOS from the SYSSERVERSESSIONS table and set BATCHJOB.STATUS = 0 (withhold), then set it back to 1 (waiting). An AOS service restart is usually the permanent fix.

knownIssues.title: SAP transport request stuck with 'RC=8'
knownIssues.content: Open the STMS_IMPORT log; it is usually a missing DDIC object or a syntax error. The developer fixes it and opens a new TR; as an interim solution, the import can be retried by checking 'Ignore Invalid Component Version'.

knownIssues.title: Turkish characters are garbled when exporting from an ERP report to Excel
knownIssues.content: The export charset produced Windows-1254 instead of UTF-8. Select Excel > Data > From Text/CSV > File origin: '65001: Unicode (UTF-8)'. For a permanent fix, set Output Settings > Encoding to 'TR-1254' in the ERP.

knownIssues.title: 'Locked Record' warning in the Logo Netsis pre-accounting module
knownIssues.content: Another session is keeping the same record open. Find the lock record in the NETOPENS table and DELETE it with the user's approval. If it recurs, lower the 'Automatic Lock Timeout' on the client to 5 minutes.

knownIssues.title: SAP Fiori Launchpad opens empty, tiles do not appear
knownIssues.content: Clear the /UI2/FLP_CUST_CONF cache; then verify the catalog and group assignment of the PFCG role assigned to the user. On the browser side, clearing site data with Ctrl+Shift+Del and logging in again is recommended.

knownIssues.title: Duplicate error when saving a customer record
knownIssues.content: The tax number is a unique field, meaning it already exists on another record. The duplicate record is merged using the 'Customer Merge' tool.

knownIssues.title: CRM mobile app does not synchronize
knownIssues.content: First, sign out of and back into the account. Then clear the app cache. If the problem persists, the SSO token lifetime (60 min) may have expired; log in again manually.

knownIssues.title: Salesforce Outlook add-in does not appear in the ribbon
knownIssues.content: Check File > Options > Add-ins > Disabled Items and 'Enable' the Salesforce add-in. If it still doesn't appear, re-deploy 'Outlook Integration' (Lightning) instead of 'Salesforce for Outlook' via the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

knownIssues.title: HubSpot email integration returns a 'Connection lost' error
knownIssues.content: The OAuth refresh token has expired. Click 'Reconnect' under Settings > General > Email > Connected inboxes; on the Microsoft 365 consent screen, grant permission to the 'HubSpot Sales' application.

knownIssues.title: Dynamics 365 CE 'Business Process Flow' does not create activities
knownIssues.content: The process is inactive or the scope is left at 'User'. Open Power Apps > Solutions > BPF, Activate it, and set the Scope to 'Organization'. Verify that the user has the 'Process User' role.

knownIssues.title: 'A required field is not filled in' warning when closing an opportunity in CRM
knownIssues.content: A stage gating rule has been added. From the form editor, find which field is required (usually 'Close Reason' or 'Revenue'); the user cannot advance the stage without filling it in. The business rule can be temporarily deactivated.

knownIssues.title: Salesforce report does not arrive as scheduled
knownIssues.content: Under Setup > Scheduled Jobs, the 'Reporting Snapshot' status may be 'Failed'. Usually the user running it has been deactivated. Grant 'Schedule Future Runs' permission to an active admin and reschedule the job.

knownIssues.title: 'Quota exceeded' error when sending bulk SMS from CRM
knownIssues.content: The daily SMS pool (e.g. 5000) is exhausted. Purchase an add-on package from the operator portal (Turkcell BiP / Vodafone Mesajım) or split the campaign over 2 days. Quota resets at 00:00 (Turkey time).

knownIssues.title: Lead assignment automation is not working
knownIssues.content: There are no active users left in the round-robin queue. Verify the team members via Setup > Queues; also, the 'Assignment Rule' must be active (Setup > Lead Assignment Rules > Active checkbox).

knownIssues.title: Form submissions from HubSpot do not reach the CRM
knownIssues.content: Workflow 're-enrollment' is disabled, or the form is missing GDPR consent. Enable the 'Always create contact' option under Marketing > Forms > Edit > Options; then enable Workflow > Settings > Re-enrollment triggers.

knownIssues.title: CRM API calls return 429 'Too Many Requests'
knownIssues.content: The integration user has exceeded the API limit (Salesforce 15,000/24h). Check System Overview > API Usage and move unnecessary polling to the 'Streaming API' (PushTopic). Temporary fix: an additional 'API Add-on' license.

knownIssues.title: CRM dashboard returns 'Insufficient privileges'
knownIssues.content: Folder sharing permission is missing. Have the dashboard owner add the relevant public group under 'Manage Folder' and grant 'View' access. In Lightning, also verify the 'Run as specified user' setting.

knownIssues.title: 'Trust Center' warning when running an Excel macro
knownIssues.content: The file is not yet in a trusted location. Save the file > File > Info > Enable Content, or sign the macro with a digital signature.

knownIssues.title: Word templates do not open
knownIssues.content: Normal.dotm may be corrupted. Delete %appdata%\Microsoft\Templates\Normal.dotm; it will be recreated when Word is reopened.

knownIssues.title: Outlook OST file has hit the 50 GB limit
knownIssues.content: Lower the Cached Exchange Mode range to 12 months via File > Account Settings > Account Settings > Change > 'Mail to keep offline'. Alternative: enable Online Archive (In-Place Archive); old mail is moved automatically.

knownIssues.title: Microsoft 365 'Need to sign in' notification keeps popping up
knownIssues.content: The Modern Authentication WAM cache is corrupted. Delete the %localappdata%\Microsoft\OneAuth and %localappdata%\Microsoft\IdentityCache folders and reopen the application. If that doesn't permanently fix it, remove the 'MicrosoftOffice*' entries from Credential Manager.

knownIssues.title: PowerPoint 'An error occurred while starting the slide show'
knownIssues.content: Hardware graphics acceleration is problematic. Check File > Options > Advanced > Display > 'Disable hardware graphics acceleration'. If there is an embedded video, use a local file instead of Insert > Video > Online.

knownIssues.title: Outlook search says 'No results' but the mail exists
knownIssues.content: The Windows Search index is corrupted. Click Control Panel > Indexing Options > Advanced > Rebuild. On the Outlook side, verify that Outlook is checked under File > Options > Search > Indexing Options; the rebuild takes 30-60 min.

knownIssues.title: Excel file opens very slowly from a network share
knownIssues.content: AutoSave + a large file + SMB latency triggers it. Set the 'AutoRecover' interval to 20 min via File > Options > Save; if possible, move the file to OneDrive/SharePoint so that Office only synchronizes the delta.

knownIssues.title: Formulas return #NAME? when opening an xlsx in LibreOffice Calc
knownIssues.content: Microsoft-specific functions (XLOOKUP, LET) do not exist in older LibreOffice. Check Tools > Macros > 'Use English function names', then update to version 7.5+. Alternative: convert the file to .ods.

knownIssues.title: OneDrive does not synchronize, saying 'File in use'
knownIssues.content: An Office application is holding the file in the background. End the EXCEL.EXE / WINWORD.EXE processes from Task Manager. To prevent recurrence, you can disable OneDrive > Settings > Office > 'Use Office applications to sync'.

knownIssues.title: Outlook 'Cannot expand the folder' error
knownIssues.content: Access permission to the shared mailbox has been removed. Re-add 'Full Access' via EAC > recipients > mailboxes > Mailbox Delegation. On the client, run outlook.exe /resetnavpane.

knownIssues.title: Word 'There was a problem sending the command' error
knownIssues.content: This is a DDE conflict. Under File > Options > Advanced > General, the 'Ignore other applications that use DDE' checkbox is CLEARED. If that has no effect, open Word in safe mode (winword.exe /safe) and disable add-ins one by one.

knownIssues.title: Visio diagram gives a 'Stencil locked' warning
knownIssues.content: The template file is checked out by another user. Check it in from the SharePoint library, or have an admin perform 'Discard Check Out'. On the local copy, delete the .vssx lock files under %appdata%\Microsoft\Visio.

knownIssues.title: Chrome extension cannot be installed due to corporate policy
knownIssues.content: Only allow-listed extensions can be installed via GPO. The requesting user fills out the 'Browser Extension Request' form, and it is added after Information Security approval.

knownIssues.title: Edge 'InPrivate' mode does not open
knownIssues.content: The corporate Edge policy may disable InPrivate. The GPO 'InPrivateModeAvailability = 1' is active; if there is a business need, IT Security adds an exception.

knownIssues.title: 'ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID' appears in Chrome on internal applications
knownIssues.content: The corporate Root CA certificate has not been pushed to the computer. Assign the 'Trusted Certificate' profile to the user via Intune > Devices > Configuration, or manually import the .cer under certlm.msc > Trusted Root.

knownIssues.title: Edge profiles keep resetting
knownIssues.content: This is a conflict between the roaming profile and Edge's 'User Data' folder. Disable 'Roam Microsoft Edge data' via GPO; instead, enable the 'Sync' feature with AAD (Edge://settings/profiles/sync).

knownIssues.title: Firefox ESR does not update automatically
knownIssues.content: In the corporate version the update channel is 'esr', and 'DisableAppUpdate' may be active via GPO. Verify the policy from the about:policies page; deploy the update from the package management system (SCCM/Intune).

knownIssues.title: Chrome does not automatically log into the intranet application via SSO
knownIssues.content: The Integrated Authentication setting is missing. Registry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\Chrome\AuthServerAllowlist = '*.firma.local'. Also add the URL under Internet Options > Security > Local Intranet > Sites > Advanced.

knownIssues.title: Edge IE Mode does not work on the target site
knownIssues.content: The site is not defined in the Enterprise Mode Site List XML. Update SitelistUrl via M365 admin > Edge > Configuration policies > 'Configure Internet Explorer integration', then trigger 'Force update' via edge://compat/enterprise.

knownIssues.title: 'NET::ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID' error in the browser
knownIssues.content: The system time is wrong, or the certificate has genuinely expired. First, synchronize the clock with w32tm /resync. If it still persists, open a certificate renewal request to the Information Security team.

knownIssues.title: Chrome consumes over 4 GB of memory, the system slows down
knownIssues.content: Memory Saver is disabled. Enable 'Memory Saver' via chrome://settings/performance. If many tabs are open, 'Tab Groups' is recommended; for long-running work, Edge's 'Sleeping tabs' feature is more aggressive.

knownIssues.title: In Edge, PDFs open in Adobe instead of the browser
knownIssues.content: The default PDF handler has been set to Adobe Reader. Turn OFF Settings > Cookies and site permissions > PDF documents > 'Always download PDF files'. Select 'Microsoft Edge' for .pdf under Windows > Default Apps.

knownIssues.title: Firefox does not work through the corporate proxy
knownIssues.content: Firefox does not automatically pick up the system proxy. Go to about:preferences#general > Network Settings > 'Use system proxy settings', or enter a manual PAC URL. For GPO deployment, use the mozilla.cfg + autoconfig.js method.

knownIssues.title: Chrome 'Managed by your organization' message cannot be removed
knownIssues.content: The computer is joined to the domain, so this message is normal. List the active policies with chrome://policy. When a personal device leaves the domain, clear the HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\Chrome key.

knownIssues.title: Office 'There is a problem with your license' warning
knownIssues.content: The license pool may be full. Unbind the license from old devices (Microsoft 365 Admin > Active users). Once a new license is assigned to the user, Office reactivates within 24 hours.

knownIssues.title: Adobe Acrobat Pro says 'Subscription expired'
knownIssues.content: Renew the license entitlement from the Adobe Admin Console. The user performs 'Help > Sign Out' > signs in again.

knownIssues.title: Windows 'Activate Windows' watermark has reappeared
knownIssues.content: Communication with the KMS server has not been renewed within 180 days. Command: slmgr.vbs /skms kms.firma.local:1688 followed by slmgr.vbs /ato. If it still does not activate, verify TCP port 1688 in the firewall.

knownIssues.title: Office Volume License (KMS) activation error 0xC004F074
knownIssues.content: The KMS host count is below 5, or the client cannot find the KMS host. Run ospp.vbs /sethst:kms.firma.local, then ospp.vbs /act. Check the _vlmcs._tcp SRV record in DNS.

knownIssues.title: Adobe Creative Cloud 'Sign-in required' recurs
knownIssues.content: There is an issue with the Federated ID + SAML token lifetime. Delete C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Adobe\OOBE\opm.db and log into the machine again. If that doesn't resolve it, 'Reset SAML federation' via Adobe Admin Console > Identity is recommended.

knownIssues.title: AutoCAD 'License manager not functioning' error
knownIssues.content: Because it is a network license, the FlexLM (lmgrd) service has stopped. On the license server, perform LMTools > 'Stop Server' > 'Start Server'. On the client, delete the %programdata%\Autodesk\CLM\LGS.data file and trigger a sign-in again.

knownIssues.title: Microsoft 365 license is assigned but Teams says 'You are missing a license'
knownIssues.content: Teams has been disabled within the service plan scope. Check 'Microsoft Teams' under Admin Center > Users > Licenses and apps > Apps. Wait 1-2 hours for replication, then clear the Teams cache (%appdata%\Microsoft\Teams).

knownIssues.title: A machine with Visio Plan 2 installed says 'Unlicensed Product'
knownIssues.content: The same user may have a different Office Click-to-Run version (e.g. a mix of Volume + M365). Completely remove Office with the 'Microsoft Support and Recovery Assistant' (SaRA) and install only Visio M365 with an ODT configuration.

knownIssues.title: OEM Windows license is invalid after a hardware change
knownIssues.content: An OEM license is tied to the motherboard and will not activate on a new one. Try the Settings > Activation > Troubleshoot > 'I changed hardware on this device recently' step; if it fails, switch to a MAK/KMS corporate license.

knownIssues.title: SQL Server 'Evaluation period has expired' error
knownIssues.content: The 180-day trial period has expired. Enter a valid corporate product key via SQL Server Installation Center > Maintenance > 'Edition Upgrade'. After an automatic service restart, it runs as Standard/Enterprise.

knownIssues.title: 'Assign licenses' button is disabled in the M365 admin
knownIssues.content: The license count in the tenant is 0, or the user has already taken the max product (e.g. two Exchange plans). Purchase more via Billing > Your products > 'Buy licenses', or run Set-MgUserLicense -RemoveLicenses with PowerShell to remove the conflicting plan.

knownIssues.title: Adobe shared device license asks for sign-in on every startup on a classroom computer
knownIssues.content: The Shared Device License was not installed with the correct profile. Create a new 'Shared Device License' package via Adobe Admin Console > Packages, with deployment mode 'Shared Device'. When deployed via SCCM/Intune, the student user will not be asked again after SSO.

knownIssues.title: OneDrive says 'You're up to date' but the file does not sync
knownIssues.content: If the path exceeds 400 characters, the sync fails. Shorten the folder name, or turn 'Files On-Demand' off and back on.

knownIssues.title: OneDrive synchronization is producing conflict files
knownIssues.content: Two devices may be editing at the same time. On one device, set OneDrive to 'pause', choose the version that resolves the issue, then synchronize.

knownIssues.title: Cannot sign in to OneDrive for Business with 'Error 0x8004de40'
knownIssues.content: TLS 1.2 or proxy settings may be blocking it. Enable TLS 1.2 from Internet Options > Advanced; then run the command %localappdata%\Microsoft\OneDrive\onedrive.exe /reset.

knownIssues.title: Synced files show a 'Locked by another user' warning
knownIssues.content: The same file may have been left open in Office Web Apps. Force a check-in from SharePoint Admin Center > Active Users, or have the user release the file with 'Discard checkout'.

knownIssues.title: Known Folder Move (KFM) is not being applied via GPO
knownIssues.content: The Tenant ID may have been entered incorrectly in the GPO. Paste the Entra tenant ID into the 'Silently move Windows known folders to OneDrive' policy and run the gpupdate /force command.

knownIssues.title: OneDrive disk space is filling up but 'Free up space' does not work
knownIssues.content: Files On-Demand may have been disabled. Enable 'Save space and download files as you use them' in Settings; then right-click the files > apply 'Free up space'.

knownIssues.title: A shared link returns the error 'This item might not exist'
knownIssues.content: The file may have passed the 93-day Recycle Bin period and been permanently deleted. Check the second-stage bin from SharePoint Admin Center > More features > Recycle bin; if it is not there, restore is not possible.

knownIssues.title: On the Mac client, OneDrive gets stuck in an 'Authentication needed' loop
knownIssues.content: The old credential in the Keychain may be corrupted. Delete the 'OneDrive' entries in Keychain Access, close the app with Cmd+Q and reopen it, then re-add the account.

knownIssues.title: The sync icon shows a red X but no error message appears
knownIssues.content: A file name containing an invalid character (* : < > ? / \ |) is halting the sync. From the OneDrive icon in the system tray > open 'View sync problems', and rename the file.

knownIssues.title: A former employee's OneDrive data cannot be transferred to the manager
knownIssues.content: The transfer must be done before the retention period (default 30 days) expires. In M365 Admin Center > Active users > select the user, and from the 'OneDrive' tab use 'Access files' to give the new owner a link.

knownIssues.title: Due to Conditional Access, the OneDrive mobile app asks for 'compliance'
knownIssues.content: The device may appear non-compliant in Intune. Complete enrollment via the Company Portal until the user's device shows as 'Compliant' in Entra > Devices.

knownIssues.title: An 'Upload blocked' warning appears during a bulk upload
knownIssues.content: A DLP policy may have detected sensitive data. Review the policy match from M365 Compliance > Data loss prevention > Alerts; if it is a false positive, add an exclusion.

knownIssues.title: 'Sorry, you don't have access' when loading a SharePoint site
knownIssues.content: The user is missing from the site permission list. Request that the site owner add them to the 'Members' group.

knownIssues.title: Bulk file deletion gets stuck at the limit (5000 items)
knownIssues.content: More than 5000 files cannot be deleted at once. Run a batch script with PowerShell, or use the Recycle Bin PowerShell module.

knownIssues.title: A modern list does not apply a filter due to the 'List view threshold'
knownIssues.content: On lists with more than 5000 items, filtering by a non-indexed column does not work. Index the relevant column from Site Settings > List settings > Indexed columns.

knownIssues.title: SharePoint search is not indexing new documents
knownIssues.content: Crawl delay can take 15 min to 2 hours. Trigger 'Reindex site' from SharePoint Admin Center > More features > Search; if it is critical, crawl the managed property from Manage Search Schema.

knownIssues.title: Hub site association returns a 'Cannot connect to hub' error
knownIssues.content: The target site may be in a different geo-location. Check that they are in the same region from SharePoint Admin Center > Active sites > select the site > 'Hub' tab; on multi-geo tenants, the hub must be in the same geo.

knownIssues.title: An Excel file says 'Workbook is locked for editing' in the browser
knownIssues.content: Co-authoring is disabled or the WOPI cache is stuck. Enable 'Opening in the browser' from Library Settings > Advanced settings; if needed, clear the lock with Set-SPOSite -DisableCompanyWideSharingLinks.

knownIssues.title: A Power Automate flow SharePoint trigger is not firing
knownIssues.content: The flow connection owner may have left the company. Check Power Automate portal > My flows > Run history, and connect the service account via 'Edit connection'.

knownIssues.title: Turkish characters appear corrupted in the culture column
knownIssues.content: The site locale is set incorrectly. Set Site Settings > Regional settings > Locale to 'Turkish (Turkey)', and update per user in M365 > Settings > Language and region.

knownIssues.title: Versioning history shows a 'Major version limit reached' warning
knownIssues.content: The library may be approaching the 50,000 version limit. Lower 'Number of major versions' to 500 in Library Settings > Versioning settings, and clean up unnecessary versions.

knownIssues.title: An external user was invited but gets 'Access denied'
knownIssues.content: The tenant sharing policy must be 'New and existing guests'. Select 'Anyone' or 'New and existing guests' from SharePoint Admin Center > Policies > Sharing; then check Entra > External Identities > Guest invite settings.

knownIssues.title: The site collection storage quota is full and uploads fail
