knownIssues.content: Increase the quota with Set-SPOSite -Identity https://tenant.sharepoint.com/sites/X -StorageQuota 51200. If there is no room in the tenant pool, purchase additional storage from M365 Admin Center > Billing > Add-ons.

knownIssues.title: Links return 404 after a migration
knownIssues.content: No redirect was created during the URL rename. If 'Change site address' was used in SharePoint Admin Center > Active sites, check status with Get-SPOSiteRenameJob; apply the manual link mapping CSV with Invoke-SPOSiteSwap.

knownIssues.title: An Azure VM does not start with an 'Allocation failed' error
knownIssues.content: The relevant SKU is out of stock in the region. Solution: try an alternative region or a different VM size. For Tier-1 production, open a capacity reservation.

knownIssues.title: No MFA Microsoft Authenticator notification is received
knownIssues.content: The push service may be blocked on the device. Tap 'check for approvals' inside the app; if that does not work, re-register the MFA device.

knownIssues.title: Conditional Access marks a sign-in from a new device as 'Blocked by policy'
knownIssues.content: The trusted locations or compliant device requirement is being triggered. Identify which policy is blocking it from Entra > Security > Conditional Access > Sign-in logs, and put it in 'Report-only' mode if needed.

knownIssues.title: Azure AD Connect synchronization returns 'stopped-server-down'
knownIssues.content: Access to the on-prem DC was lost. Run Start-ADSyncSyncCycle -PolicyType Delta on the sync server; if it fails, check the connector status with miisclient.exe.

knownIssues.title: App Service returns 502 during a deployment slot swap
knownIssues.content: The warm-up endpoint is not responding. Add WEBSITE_SWAP_WARMUP_PING_PATH=/health and WEBSITE_SWAP_WARMUP_PING_STATUSES=200 in App Service > Configuration > Application settings.

knownIssues.title: An AKS pod gets an 'ImagePullBackOff' error
knownIssues.content: The AKS managed identity does not have access to ACR. Connect it with az aks update -n cluster -g rg --attach-acr myacr; then restart the pod with kubectl rollout restart deployment/<name>.

knownIssues.title: Azure Blob Storage returns 'AuthorizationFailure'
knownIssues.content: The SAS token has expired or there is an IP restriction. Check the whitelist in Storage account > Networking > Firewall; generate a new token with az storage account generate-sas.

knownIssues.title: Azure SQL DB issues a 'DTU exhausted' warning
knownIssues.content: Query performance tuning is required. Analyze the top resource consumers from Azure portal > SQL DB > Query Performance Insight; as a temporary fix, raise the tier with az sql db update --service-objective S3.

knownIssues.title: An Entra ID group does not appear in Intune
knownIssues.content: The dynamic group rule is wrong or the sync has not completed yet. Verify Entra > Groups > Dynamic membership rules; trigger 'Process rules' for a manual refresh — propagation takes 5-30 min.

knownIssues.title: The Service Principal secret expired and the pipeline broke
knownIssues.content: Generate a new secret with az ad sp credential reset --id <appId>. Save the new secret to Key Vault; update it in the pipeline via DevOps > Service connections > Edit.

knownIssues.title: Azure Front Door custom domain SSL shows 'CertificateNotFound'
knownIssues.content: The domain validation TXT record has not been added. Write the _dnsauth.<host> TXT record to DNS from Front Door > Domains; then click 'Revalidate' — the certificate is provisioned within 1-2 hours.

knownIssues.title: Log Analytics workspace ingestion shows 'Daily cap reached'
knownIssues.content: The daily data limit was exceeded and new logs are being dropped. Raise or disable the daily cap from Log Analytics workspace > Usage and estimated costs > Daily cap; in the long term, shorten the retention of unnecessary tables.

knownIssues.title: An S3 bucket is closed to public access but the URL is open
knownIssues.content: The bucket policy and CORS must be checked separately. Even with Block Public Access ON, access can be provided via a signed URL; real public access is not open.

knownIssues.title: EC2 SSH returns 'Connection timeout'
knownIssues.content: Inbound port 22 is missing in the Security Group. If there is no Internet Gateway in the VPC route table, public access is not possible; use a bastion host.

knownIssues.title: RDS rejects write operations due to 'Storage full'
knownIssues.content: Auto-scaling may have been left off. Increase it with the command aws rds modify-db-instance --db-instance-identifier prod --allocated-storage 200 --apply-immediately; in the long term, enable storage autoscaling.

knownIssues.title: A Lambda function returns 'Task timed out after 3.00 seconds'
knownIssues.content: The default 3-second timeout is insufficient. Increase it with aws lambda update-function-configuration --function-name X --timeout 30; for cold starts, consider provisioned concurrency.

knownIssues.title: An IAM user gets an 'AccessDenied' error although the policy looks correct
knownIssues.content: An SCP (Service Control Policy) at the Organizations level may be blocking it. Test the effective permission with aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn <arn> --action-names s3:GetObject.

knownIssues.title: A CloudWatch alarm is stuck in the 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA' state
knownIssues.content: The metric is not being published or the namespace is wrong. Check whether data is arriving with aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics; if the agent is not installed, push the CloudWatch Agent via SSM.

knownIssues.title: EKS cluster nodes are dropping to the 'NotReady' state
knownIssues.content: The kubelet may be unable to reach the CNI plugin. Review the events with kubectl describe node; restart the aws-node DaemonSet, and verify that AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy is attached to the IAM role.

knownIssues.title: A Route 53 DNS record is not propagating
knownIssues.content: The TTL was left high or the client cache was not cleared. Check the authoritative answer with dig @8.8.8.8 <host>; flush the local cache with ipconfig /flushdns, and lower the TTL to 60s going forward.

knownIssues.title: Restore from S3 Glacier returns 'RestoreAlreadyInProgress'
knownIssues.content: The previous restore has not completed. Check the Restore header with aws s3api head-object --bucket X --key Y; the Standard tier averages 3-5 hours, Bulk 5-12 hours.

knownIssues.title: VPC peering was set up but packets are being dropped
knownIssues.content: The peering entry is missing from both sides' route tables. Add a manual route with aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-xxx --destination-cidr-block 10.0.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-xxx, and allow the peer CIDR in the security group.

knownIssues.title: A CloudFormation stack is stuck in the 'UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED' state
knownIssues.content: The rollback failed due to drift or a manual change. Skip the problematic resource with aws cloudformation continue-update-rollback --stack-name X --resources-to-skip <LogicalId>; then run drift detection.

knownIssues.title: Cost Explorer 'Unblended cost' increased unexpectedly
knownIssues.content: It may be NAT Gateway data transfer or an unused EIP. Review the details from Cost Explorer > Group by 'Usage Type'; identify idle EIPs with aws ec2 describe-addresses and release them.

knownIssues.title: A Veeam backup returns a 'Backup repository full' error
knownIssues.content: Manually clean up old backups that have fallen outside the retention policy. Moving long-term storage to S3 Glacier is recommended.

knownIssues.title: File checksum mismatch during a restore
knownIssues.content: There may be corruption on the repository. Trigger a 'Health Check' job; corrupted blocks are fixed in the next backup.

knownIssues.title: Azure Backup VM snapshot returns 'UserErrorVmNotInDesirableState'
knownIssues.content: The VM may be in a deallocated state. Start it from Azure portal > VM > Start; then manually trigger 'Backup now' from Recovery Services Vault > Backup jobs.

knownIssues.title: Veeam Proxy returns a 'Failed to process disk' VDDK error
knownIssues.content: The vCenter certificate may have changed. Accept the new thumbprint via Veeam Console > Backup Infrastructure > Managed Servers > right-click vCenter > 'Properties'.

knownIssues.title: A Commvault MediaAgent issues a 'Network path not found' warning
knownIssues.content: The CIFS share credentials have expired. Update the domain user password from CommCell Console > Storage Resources > Library > MountPath > 'Modify access path'.

knownIssues.title: Rubrik SLA domain violation (SLA Compliance < 100%)
knownIssues.content: The job window is insufficient or there is a bandwidth bottleneck. Open the 'Missed Snapshots' details from Rubrik UI > Reports > SLA Compliance, and widen the job window or remove throttling.

knownIssues.title: The Acronis agent returns a 'Cannot connect to management server' error
knownIssues.content: The Acronis Agent service has stopped or port 9877 is closed. Restart 'Acronis Managed Machine Service' from Services.msc; open TCP 9877 outbound in the firewall.

knownIssues.title: An old backup cannot be deleted due to an AWS Backup vault lock
knownIssues.content: Compliance mode lock is active; deletion is rejected until the minimum retention period expires. Check MinRetentionDays with aws backup describe-backup-vault; admin override is only possible in governance mode.

knownIssues.title: SQL Server transaction log backup says 'log chain broken'
knownIssues.content: A full backup was skipped or the recovery model changed. Verify the recovery model is 'Full' in SSMS > Database > Properties > Options > Recovery model; take a new FULL backup to restart the log chain.

knownIssues.title: A restore from S3 Glacier Deep Archive is taking more than 48 hours
knownIssues.content: The Bulk retrieval tier may have been selected. Choose the Standard tier (~12 hours) with aws s3api restore-object --restore-request 'Days=7,GlacierJobParameters={Tier=Standard}'.

knownIssues.title: A Veeam tape job issues a 'No suitable media' warning
knownIssues.content: The free media pool is empty or the barcode is not recognized. Add media manually to the 'Free' pool from Tape Infrastructure > Media Pools; if needed, re-run Inventory in the tape library.

knownIssues.title: Office 365 backup (Veeam VBO) returns 'Throttling detected'
knownIssues.content: The Microsoft Graph API rate limit has been exceeded. Increase the number of Backup Proxies and reduce the number of concurrent jobs in the VBO Console; wait 24 hours for the per-mailbox throttling to reset.

knownIssues.title: After a bare-metal restore, the system gives an 'INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE' BSOD
knownIssues.content: The restored hardware is different; there is a driver mismatch. Inject the new HAL and storage driver with the Acronis Universal Restore or Veeam 'Universal Restore' wizard, then reboot the system.
